hero_sub: A practical AI roadmap for turning missed electrical calls, estimate follow-up, scheduling friction, and repeat-customer opportunities into a system Billy Bob Electric can run every day.
profile_note: Billy Bob Electric is already operating with enough lead volume and job value for AI to pay back quickly if it protects urgent calls, improves follow-up, and reduces scheduling drag.

results.title: Electrical contractors are using automation to protect response time and job capacity.
results.sub: The biggest wins are not abstract AI projects. They are practical improvements around emergency triage, quote follow-up, scheduling, permit prep, and review generation.

cards.title: Emergency calls get priority faster
cards.desc: Electrical emergencies lose value when they wait in a general inbox. AI can classify urgency and push true emergencies to dispatch immediately.

cards.title: Quotes stop going cold
cards.desc: Panel upgrades, EV chargers, and lighting projects often need timely follow-up. AI can personalize reminders without adding office workload.

cards.title: Technician days get tighter
cards.desc: Small schedule improvements compound when every truck can complete more jobs with less back-and-forth.

results.close: For Billy Bob Electric, the fastest path is not replacing the team. It is giving the team an always-on layer for triage, follow-up, and scheduling.

demo.sub: This demo focuses on a real-world electrical service call: classify urgency, collect missing details, and route the customer to the right next step.
demo.note: The point is not a chatbot novelty. It is a faster front door for jobs Billy Bob Electric already wants.

prompts.title: Emergency Triage Agent
prompts.subtitle: Classify incoming electrical requests
prompts.pre: You are the Emergency Dispatch Agent for Billy Bob Electric. Classify each inquiry as emergency, urgent, quote, or routine. Ask only for missing safety details, property address, and callback number. Route emergency issues immediately.
prompts.outcome: Every new request gets sorted before the office loses time.

prompts.title: Quote Follow-Up Agent
prompts.subtitle: Recover open estimates
prompts.pre: You are the Quote Follow-Up Agent for Billy Bob Electric. Write a concise follow-up for an open electrical estimate. Reference the job type, remind the customer of safety/value, and offer two scheduling windows.
prompts.outcome: More $1,000 jobs move from estimate to scheduled work.

prompts.title: Technician Scheduling Agent
prompts.subtitle: Plan daily job flow
prompts.pre: You are the Technician Scheduling Agent for Billy Bob Electric. Given job type, drive time, technician skill, and urgency, recommend a daily schedule that minimizes travel and protects emergencies.
prompts.outcome: The team completes more jobs with less coordination.

cta_personal: Billy, your best first move is not a giant AI overhaul. It is a focused system that protects urgent electrical calls, follows up on estimates, and gives your office time back.

calc.sub: Use these numbers as the Billy Bob Electric baseline: $1,000 average customer value, 160 monthly leads, 35% close rate, and 35 weekly admin hours.

prompt_1: You are a speed-to-lead response agent for Billy Bob Electric. Classify electrical inquiries by urgency and draft a direct response within 60 seconds.
prompt_2: You are a quote follow-up agent for Billy Bob Electric. Draft a customer-specific follow-up for an open estimate and offer two scheduling windows.
prompt_3: You are an outreach agent for Billy Bob Electric. Generate local referral and review request messages for completed electrical jobs.
